merchants.summary: R&K Cocina is a genuine, independently verifiable Nicaraguan food truck/eatery with a public listing at 2075 Alum Rock Ave, San Jose, CA and dated five-star reviews running from March 2025, so the business exists, has over a year of operating history and shows no adverse or fraud reports.
